metadata.description: Thirty-one IT and network agents. Each reads files an IT team exports, writes reports locally and waits for a named person before anything that changes a live device, firewall, DNS zone, directory or cloud account.

plugins.name: iris-of-traffic
plugins.description: Network flow review from a NetFlow, IPFIX or sFlow export: cleartext protocols, risky ports reached from the internet, one host or destination taking most of the bytes, large uploads out of hours and very small packets. Writes a worklist and drafts a change request a network owner applies.
